en.headline: CFS suspends poultry imports from areas in Norway, Britain and Netherlands
en.dek: The Centre for Food Safety acted after World Organisation for Animal Health notifications of highly pathogenic H5N1 outbreaks in the three locations.
body: The Centre for Food Safety of the Food and Environmental Hygiene Department said on Thursday it had instructed the trade to suspend the import of poultry meat and products, including poultry eggs, from specified areas in Norway, Britain and the Netherlands with immediate effect.

The affected areas are Lindesnes Municipality of Agder County in Norway, the West Lindsey District of Lincolnshire County in Britain, and the Province of Friesland in the Netherlands. The move followed notifications from the World Organisation for Animal Health about outbreaks of highly pathogenic H5N1 avian influenza in those places.

A Centre spokesman said the Centre had contacted the Norwegian, British and Dutch authorities and would continue to monitor information from the World Organisation for Animal Health and the relevant authorities, taking appropriate action as the situation develops. The suspension is intended to protect public health in Hong Kong.

zh.headline: 食安中心暫停挪威、英國及荷蘭部分地區禽肉產品進口
zh.dek: 食物安全中心接獲世界動物衞生組織有關高致病性H5N1禽流感爆發的通知後，即時採取行動。
body: 食物環境衞生署食物安全中心周四表示，已指示業界即時暫停從挪威、英國及荷蘭指定地區進口禽肉及禽類產品，包括禽蛋。
受影響地區包括挪威阿格德爾郡林德斯內斯市、英國林肯郡西林賽區，以及荷蘭弗里斯蘭省。中心是接獲世界動物衞生組織關於這些地區爆發高致病性H5N1禽流感的通知後作出決定。
中心發言人表示，已與挪威、英國及荷蘭當局聯絡，並會繼續監察世界動物衞生組織及相關機構的資訊，視情況採取適當行動。暫停進口是為保障本港公眾健康。
